meta.promptText: Dark spots aur dull skin ke liye India mein konsa vitamin C serum kharidun?

response.text:
India mein dark spots aur dull skin ke liye 2026 mein kai behtareen aur dermat-tested Vitamin C serums available hain. Aap apni skin type aur budget ke hisaab se niche diye gaye options mein se chun sakte hain:

---

### Top Vitamin C Serums in India

| Serum & Brand | Key Ingredients | Best For |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Minimalist 10% Vitamin C** | 10% Ethyl Ascorbic Acid + Centella Water | Beginners, sensitive skin, aur gentle glow ke liye. |
| **Deconstruct Vitamin C Serum** | 10% Vitamin C + 0.5% Ferulic Acid | Dull skin aur antioxidant boost ke liye. |
| **Plum 15% Vitamin C Face Serum** | 15% Ethyl Ascorbic Acid + Mandarin | Brightening aur thodi experienced skin ke liye. |
| **The Derma Co. 10% Vitamin C Serum** | 10% Vitamin C + 5% Niacinamide | Dark spots aur hyperpigmentation ke ekdum target treatment ke liye. |
| **Kiehl's Clearly Corrective Dark Spot Solution** | Activated C + Salicylic Acid | Premium/Luxury skincare, jo fast results chahte hain. |

---

### Kuch Zaroori Tips (Buying & Application):

* **Concentration:** Agar aapki skin naye hai ya sensitive hai, toh **10% Vitamin C** se shuru karein. Agar skin aadi ho chuki hai, tab aap **15% ya 20%** try kar sakte hain.
* **Storage:** Vitamin C jaldi oxidize (kharab) ho jata hai, isliye ise thandi aur andheri jagah par rakhein (kuch serums ko fridge mein rakhna behtar hota hai).
* **Sunscreen:** Subah Vitamin C lagane ke baad **Sunscreen** lagana bilkul na bhulein, warna treatment ka asar kam ho jata hai.
